slider.slide1: Welcome to the Department of CIT

about.title: About the Department
about.subtitle: The Department of Computer Information Technologies is a modern educational and scientific unit that trains highly qualified specialists in the field of information technology.
about.missionText: To provide quality training for IT specialists capable of solving complex applied problems, implementing innovations and being competitive on the global labor market.
about.achievementsText: Students of the department annually win Ukrainian and international competitions, hackathons, and graduates work in leading IT companies worldwide.
about.whyUsText1: The Department of Computer Information Technologies combines fundamental theoretical training with practical skills required by the modern IT industry. We use the latest teaching methods, actively implement a project-based approach and internships in real companies.
about.whyUsText2: Our teachers are practitioners with experience in IT, certified specialists who constantly improve their qualifications, including abroad. We train not just programmers, but engineers of the future.
about.moreInfo: Would you like to learn more?
about.moreInfoText: Visit the <contacts>Contacts</contacts> section, check out the <staff>staff</staff> or go to <news>news</news> to stay up to date.

admissions.title: Admissions 2026
admissions.modernEducationDesc: Study web development, Python, DevOps, databases with up-to-date programs.
admissions.practiceDesc: Internships at SoftServe, EPAM, GlobalLogic with employment opportunities.
admissions.dormitoryDesc: Comfortable living for non-resident students with high-speed internet.
admissions.internationalDesc: Exchanges and internships abroad via Erasmus+, double degree programs.
admissions.subjects: NMT competitive subjects: mathematics, Ukrainian language, physics or foreign language
admissions.courses: Preparatory courses: free for registered applicants
admissions.faq1q: What documents are required for admission?
admissions.faq1a: NMT certificate, certificate of complete secondary education, passport, tax ID, medical certificate (form 086-o).
admissions.faq2q: Are there preparatory courses for the NMT?
admissions.faq2a: Yes, the department offers free online courses in mathematics and physics for registered applicants. Schedule will be published in April.
admissions.faq3q: What are the career prospects after graduation?
admissions.faq3a: Graduates work as web developers, DevOps engineers, data analysts, cybersecurity specialists. Average junior salary is $800–1200.

admissionBlock.title: Admissions 2026
admissionBlock.description: Choose the specialty «Computer Science» at the KIT department. Modern education, practice in IT companies, internships abroad.
